name: Izumi Iori
source:
Iori Izumi is Mitsuki Izumi's younger brother who has a "cool" personality. His parents run a cake shop called “Fonte Chocolat” where the interior is decorated cutely, which influences him to like cute things. 

[Taken from [url=https://idolish7.miraheze.org/wiki/Iori_Izumi]IDOLiSH7 Wiki[/url]]
